shots.prompt:
[shot] wide shot, locked-off static composition, the camera never moves, no zoom, no pan, no parallax
[subject] he stands without moving, the pauldron and the hair pulled to one side by the wind, weight on the back foot
[place] a storm-lit plain at dusk, a single road running to the horizon, black treeline, wind pulling his coat sideways
[environment] telephone wires perfectly still across the top of the frame
[end] by the last frame: he has not moved his feet; the coat is still pulled to one side
[look] 2D cel animation, flat colour fields, hard-edged shadows, constant line width, clean line art, limited palette of deep blue and warm amber, anime background painting, no gradients except the sky band, no texture, no photographic detail, no depth of field, no 3D render
[negative] no camera movement at all, no drift, no reframing, no parallax, no text, no subtitle
